inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject the edge if PYUSD adoption remains immaterial, partner terms prevent attractive economics, compliance costs offset revenue, or customers and merchants do not use the rail beyond speculative transfers.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Digital-finance adoption can transmit into PayPal through PayPal and Venmo distribution, compliance and settlement reach for PYUSD if usage produces material recurring transaction or reserve-sharing economics.

objective: Review whether PayPal has a material causal relationship to digital finance and crypto rails through PYUSD distribution, PayPal and Venmo reach, compliance, settlement use, partner economics, and regulatory obligations; accept or reject the edge.
